- (southern part of Norway, precipitation, higher) maybe relation "precipitation amount" with object "more". But object should be entity or concept. Could use "higher precipitation" as object. Might be okay.

Better to capture statements:

   relation: "winter climate" object: "cold weather and snow".

8. Because of Norway's high latitude, there are large seasonal variations in daylight.
   relation: "seasonal daylight variation" object: "large". Or "large seasonal variations in daylight".

9. From late May to late July, the sun never completely descends beneath the horizon in areas north of the Arctic Circle.
   This is an event: "midnight sun". Could create triplet: (areas north of the Arctic Circle, phenomenon, midnight sun) with qualifier point in time "late May to late July". Or relation "has phenomenon" object "midnight sun". Use qualifiers.

10. Rest of the country experiences up to 20 hours of daylight per day during that period.
    (Rest of Norway, daylight duration, "up to 20 hours per day") with qualifier point in time "late May to late July".

11. From late November to late January, the sun never rises above the horizon in the north.
    (areas north of Norway, phenomenon, polar night) with qualifier point in time "late November to late January".

12. Daylight hours are very short in the rest of the country during that period.
    (Rest of Norway, daylight duration, "very short") qualifier point in time "late November to late January".
